title: categories.path
description: Resolve root->leaf ancestry for a batch of categories. This object validates the request payload; the response is a flat mapping {"<category_id>": ["<root_id>", ..., "<leaf_id>"]} — see $defs.Path. A category id with no row is simply absent from the mapping, mirroring the projections read() convention. The segments are category IDS (as strings), not slugs: the consumer feeds the last segment straight back into categories.features, whose payload is typed as an integer id.

category_ids.description: IDs of the categories whose ancestry to resolve.

Path.description: One response value: the category's own ancestry, root first and the category itself last. A root category answers a single-element path.
